'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Nick Culpepper LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Culpepper]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name '''Animated GIFs are not... what have you got me doing?'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' MacGyver211
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
